pairs: And there occurred a great outcry of the people and their wives against their brothers,
et uxorum ejus magnus adversus fratres suos Judæos.
Et erant qui dicerent: Filii nostri et filiæ nostræ multæ sunt nimis:
And there were those who were saying: “Our sons and our daughters are very many.
Let us receive grain as a price for them,
and then we may eat and live.”
And there were those who were saying:
and then we may receive grain during the famine.”
Mutuo sumamus pecunias in tributa regis,
“Let us borrow money for the tribute of the king,
and let us surrender our fields and vineyards.”
et nunc sicut carnes fratrum nostrorum,
“And now, as is the flesh of our brothers,
ecce nos subjugamus filios nostros et filias nostras in servitutem,
Behold, we have subjugated our sons and our daughters into servitude,
et de filiabus nostris sunt famulæ,
and some of our daughters are slaves,
nor do we have the ability to redeem them,
et agros nostros et vineas nostras alii possident.
for others possess our fields and our vineyards.”
Et iratus sum nimis cum audissem clamorem eorum secundum verba hæc:
And when I had heard their outcry in these words, I was exceedingly angry.
And my heart considered within me.
And I rebuked the nobles and the magistrates,
Usurasne singuli a fratribus vestris exigitis?
“Have you each been exacting usury from your brothers?”
Et congregavi adversum eos concionem magnam,
And I gathered together a great assembly against them.
in accord with what was possible for us,
qui venditi fuerant gentibus secundum possibilitatem nostram:
we have redeemed our brothers, the Jews, who had been sold to the Gentiles.
et vos igitur vendetis fratres vestros, et redimemus eos?
And yet you now sell your brothers, and we must redeem them?”
nor did they find anything to answer.
Non est bona res quam facitis:
“The thing that you are doing is not good.
quare non in timore Dei nostri ambulastis,
Why are you not walking in the fear of our God,
ne exprobretur nobis a gentibus inimicis nostris?
so that there may be no reproach against us from our enemies, the Gentiles?
et pueri mei commodavimus plurimis pecuniam et frumentum.
have lent money and grain to many.
Let us agree not to ask for its return.
æs alienum concedamus quod debetur nobis.
Let us forgive the other money that is owed to us.
On this day, restore their fields,
Then, too, the hundredth part of the money,
which you usually exact from them,
And they said: “We will restore it,
and we will require nothing from them.
And we will do just as you say.” And I called the priests,
and I had them swear an oath,
et adjuravi eos ut facerent juxta quod dixeram.
so that they would act in accord with what I had said.
Moreover, I shook out my lap,
Sic excutiat Deus omnem virum qui non compleverit verbum istud,
“So may God shake out every man, who does not fulfill this word.
de domo sua, et de laboribus suis:
From his house and from his labors,
so may he be shaken out and become empty.”
Fecit ergo populus sicut erat dictum.
the people acted in accord with what was said.
qua præceperat rex mihi ut essem dux in terra Juda,
on which the king had ordered me to be governor in the land of Judah,
ab anno vigesimo usque ad annum trigesimum secundum Artaxerxis regis per annos duodecim,
from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of king Artaxerxes,
et fratres mei annonas quæ ducibus debebantur non comedimus.
I and my brothers did not eat the yearly allowance that was owed to the governors.
the ones who had been before me,
were a burden to the people,
et acceperunt ab eis in pane,
and they took from them bread
and forty shekels of money each day.
And their officials also oppressed the people.
sed et ministri eorum depresserunt populum.
But I did not do so,
Ego autem non feci ita propter timorem Dei:
quin potius in opere muri ædificavi,
In fact, I preferred to build in the work of the wall,
et omnes pueri mei congregati ad opus erant.
and all my servants were gathered to do the work.
Judæi quoque et magistratus centum quinquaginta viri,
Likewise, the Jews and the magistrates, one hundred and fifty men,
et qui veniebant ad nos de gentibus quæ in circuitu nostro sunt, in mensa mea erant.
were at my table, with those who came to us from among the Gentiles that are around us.
Parabatur autem mihi per dies singulos bos unus,
Now there was prepared for me,
one ox and six choice rams,
et inter dies decem vina diversa,
I distributed diverse wines and many other things.
et annonas ducatus mei non quæsivi:
Yet I did not require my yearly allowance as governor.
For the people were greatly impoverished.
secundum omnia quæ feci populo huic.
in accord with all that I have done for this people.
